events.title: Monday Night Raffles at Currumbin RSL
events.description: Join us every Monday for Raffles, hosted by the Currumbin RSL Women’s Auxiliary! All funds raised go to Veteran support. Great prizes up for grabs each week including meat trays and other prizes. Ticket sales from 5:30pm with the draws from 6:30pm. See you in the club.

events.title: Movie Mornings at Currumbin RSL
events.description: Join us for our FREE Monthly Movie Mornings at Currumbin RSL. Each month a new movie is selected and screened upstairs in our Waterside Function space. Limited spots are available and registration is required for this event via the website or contact reception – 55347999 September Movie: The Sheep Detectives When a shepherd who reads murder mysteries to his flock every night turns up dead, his sheep are convinced its murder and set out to crack the case themselves. Starring Hugh Jackman, this clever whodunit proves that sometimes the best detectives have four legs and plenty of wool. Tea, coffee station available.

events.title: Kids Pizza Making School Holiday Workshop
events.description: Get ready for a deliciously fun school holiday activity at Currumbin RSL! Throughout the session, they’ll mix, knead, shape, portion, and stretch their own dough before topping it with their favourite ingredients. With the chef’s expert guidance, every child will be involved from start to finish — then sit down together to enjoy their creations! Dates: Tuesday 22nd September at 3pm Wednesday 23rd September at 10.30am Thursday 24th September at 10.30am Tuesday 29th September at 3pm Wednesday 30th September at 10.30am Thursday 1st October at 10.30am Time: Class runs for 1.5hours | Club doors open 10:00am Cost: $25+BF per child Ticket includes: Creating a small pizza a soft drink and a take home apron and chef hat It’s a perfect blend of fun, food, and creativity, and every child will take home great memories (and maybe a new love for cooking!). Spaces are limited — book now to secure your child’s spot in this tasty school holiday experience! Children must be accompanied by an adult at all times during the event. Adults do not need to purchase a ticket.
